display_name: 置信度候选选择网络 Phase1 七场景地面测试
description: 固定通过盲父模型源域筛选和 L_s 真值后审计的 DURA-free 置信度选择恢复器，先固定完整七景预测，再独立评分 Phase1 地面测试标签。
authorization: 用户要求研发不同路线的星地恢复网络，只看 Phase1 地面训练测试、使用 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；六场景下降不超过 3%，同时核对百分点和相对百分比口径。

code.environment: N607 GPU0 fixed inference, frozen ground Tri-SIG-TIME, CPU 2 threads, TF32 disabled; independent CPU truth-last score

data.representation: IQ [2,256], fixed input-only blind action posterior plus three noise adaptive candidates, frozen F confidence router
data.tx_sets_ref: No test truth, clean pair, U_s truth or V during inference; fixed ground test truth after all seven views
data.validation_ref: 7840 RX4/6 source validation and 3921 RX8 source holdout, previously seen in other source views
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: Ground denoiser trained on clean source IQ and frozen F outputs, no TX labels; blind parent pre-trained source only
data.augmentation: Fixed pre-existing Phase1 ground test simulated seven views

permissions.regime: Source-trained frozen candidate, fixed Phase1 ground test inference then truth-last scoring
permissions.query_use: Per-record received IQ and frozen F predictions only; no clean pair, labels or adaptation at inference
permissions.claim_scope: Repeatedly observed single-seed Phase1 ground development test, not independent blind or real satellite

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed clean source denoiser, blind source action estimator, conditional Gaussian prior, input gate .8 and F confidence margin .05; no DURA candidate inference
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source screening SHA256 2d3cac93b1e177258003891ff203d9b392f57b023cef8fcc387166ae0e017a24; fixed source prediction SHA256 7786c063c05cd50109d858587b0c490d6d1979b7f48b27831b8aad434d859817; independent source audit SHA256 c89165ca670c7e44089db9a78b948086c9d55727f7cd21d25b95b4a71d7cd535
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Passes source parent-protected selection but not DURA-protected selection; small L_s source gain, not independent blind
checkpoint.selection_rule: Source pseudo-target primary parent criterion selects gate .8, confidence margin .05. All fixed; Phase1 ground test seven views fully predicted and hashed before truth.

execution.launch_owner: Codex fixed confidence router Phase1 ground test GPU0 owner
execution.gpu_policy: GPU0 only after independent idle check; source audit exact prediction replay before target; preserve all other owners

execution.stop_rule: Stop only for provenance/role violation, output collision, nonfinite output or technical failure; preserve partial artifacts and never stop for low performance.

metric_names: per-view frozen F raw and restored accuracy
per-view clean-relative percentage point and relative percent gap
dimensions: 168000 Phase1 ground test physical records x seven views
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: experiments/phase1_score_prox/router_phase1_predict.py score (CPU, after independently verified full prediction hashes)
metrics_plan.targets_ref: All six simulated satellite views at most 3 percentage points and 3% relative below F clean; clean output degradation <=1 percentage point

notes: No target training or labels during prediction; candidate never calls DURA.
Gate and confidence margin fixed from source; F saw source L_s IDs, and ground test results have been observed repeatedly.
1047 fixed source predictions and routing choices must reproduce exactly before Phase1 ground test begins; batch fixed by that source check.
All seven x 168000 predictions hashed before CPU truth scoring; no U_s truth, V or other phase.

rows.method: input-only confidence selector over blind posterior and three noise-adaptive prior reconstructions
rows.purpose: Evaluate fixed source-selected DURA-free IQ restorer against frozen Tri-SIG-TIME clean ground test
rows.seed_notes: Source split 2026110201, physical channel 2026110202, router initialization 2026110203, fitting order 2026110204, source RX/day hardware 2026110205; fixed original Phase1 test views
rows.scenario: Source clean and independent practical low-suburban/mid-urban/low-urban views; fixed Phase1 clean and six practical received views
rows.budget_ref: 168000 ground test IDs x 7 fixed views, no model updates; gate .8 and confidence margin .05
